content:
**1) LAYOUT**
*   **Window:** 1024x768 (Maximized).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0 – 1024, 40):** Contains app icon/title (left), "Buy Now" button and window controls (right).
*   **Navigation Bar (0, 40 – 1024, 95):** Breadcrumbs (left), View/Filter/Search controls (right).
*   **Main Content Area (0, 96 – 1024, 853):** Split into three vertical panes.
    *   **Left Pane (File Tree) (0, 120 – 275, 850):** Scrollable list of file types/folders.
    *   **Center Pane (Grid View) (280, 120 – 785, 850):** Grid of file thumbnails with selection checkboxes.
    *   **Right Pane (Preview/Details) (790, 120 – 1024, 850):** Preview image, metadata, status badges, and recovery gauge.
*   **Footer / Status Bar (0, 854 – 1024, 945):** Scan completion notification (left), "Recover All..." action button (right).
*   **Windows Taskbar (0, 946 – 1024, 1000):** System UI.

**2) TEXT**
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Nav Bar:** `Pictures`, `jpeg`, `Filter`, `Search files or folders`
*   **Left Pane Header:** `Path`, `Type`
*   **Left Pane Items:** `Pictures` (`140.1K`), `jpg` (`242`), `png` (`127.5K`), `jpeg` (`78`), `gif` (`851`), `tif` (`3`), `eps` (`23`), `bmp` (`217`), `ico` (`776`), `ani` (`6`), `apm` (`5`), `arw` (`1`), `cur` (`237`)
*   **Center Pane:** `Select All`
    *   *Filenames:* `video-00...212.jpeg`, `video-00...212.jpeg`, `video-00...212.jpeg`, `video-001.cmyk.jpeg`, `video-001.cmyk.jpeg`, `video-001.cmyk.jpeg`, `video-001.jpeg`, `video-001.jpeg`, `video-01.jpeg`
*   **Right Pane:**
    *   `Preview`
    *   `Size`: `18.81 KB`
    *   `Date Modified`: `2/3/2026 8:02 PM`
    *   `Path`: `C:\hostedtoolcache\wind...`
    *   `Status`: `Existing`
    *   `Recovery Chances`: `High`
*   **Footer:** `Scan Completed, Files Found: 1139250 (149.73 GB)`
*   **Button:** `Recover All ...`, `Buy Now`

**3) COLOR**
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Window/App Background: `#F5F7FA` (ESTIMATED Light Gray/Blueish White)
    *   Left Pane Selected Item: `#E8F0FE` (ESTIMATED Light Blue)
    *   Right Pane Background: `#FFFFFF` (ESTIMATED White)
    *   Footer Background: `#FFFFFF` (ESTIMATED White)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text: `#1F1F1F` (ESTIMATED Near Black)
    *   Secondary Text/Metadata: `#5F6368` (ESTIMATED Dark Gray)
    *   Link/Accent Text: `#1677FF` (ESTIMATED Bright Blue - e.g., "Type", "Preview")
    *   "High" Text: `#10B981` (ESTIMATED Green)
*   **Accents & Borders:**
    *   Selection Border (Center): `#1677FF` (ESTIMATED Blue, ~2px)
    *   Button Primary: `#1677FF` (ESTIMATED Blue)
    *   Button Secondary ("Buy Now"): `#FFA117` (ESTIMATED Orange/Yellow)
    *   "Existing" Badge Text/Bg: Text is likely dark gray or black on a very light gray background `#F3F4F6`.
    *   Checkboxes: White bg, gray border `#D1D5DB`, blue checkmark when selected.
*   **Gauge (Recovery Chances):**
    *   Arc colors appear to be a gradient or segmented: Green (`#10B981`) to Yellow (`#F59E0B`). The needle points to the green section.

**4) TYPOGRAPHY**
*   **Window Title:** Sans-Serif, ~11px, Regular.
*   **Breadcrumbs/Headers:** Sans-Serif, ~13-14px, Medium weight.
*   **File List Items:** Sans-Serif, ~13px, Regular.
*   **Metadata Labels (Right Pane):** Sans-Serif, ~12px, Regular, Gray.
*   **Metadata Values (Right Pane):** Sans-Serif, ~12px, Regular/SemiBold, Dark Gray/Black.
*   **Status/Footer Text:** Sans-Serif, ~13-14px, Medium.
*   **Button Text:** Sans-Serif, ~13px, Medium, White (on blue).

**5) SPACING & SIZING**
*   **Thumbnails (Center):** Approx 120x90 px. Grid gap approx 15-20px.
*   **List Item Height (Left):** Approx 32-36px.
*   **Preview Image (Right):** Approx 200x140 px.
*   **Button Heights:** Nav bar icons ~36px; "Recover All" ~40px; "Buy Now" ~28px.
*   **Padding:** Right pane content has approx 20px padding from edges. Footer has approx 16px vertical padding.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Buttons: ~4-6px.
    *   Thumbnails: ~2-4px (slight rounding).
    *   Input/Search bar: ~4px.
    *   "Buy Now" button: ~14px (pill shape).

**6) CONTROLS & STATES**
*   **Checkboxes:**
    *   Top-left of center pane: Unchecked (Normal).
    *   On thumbnails: Unchecked (Normal). The first thumbnail has a visual focus/selection state indicated by the blue border, but the checkbox itself appears unchecked in this specific frame (or it's a "focused but not checked" state, though typically selection implies check). The blue border indicates **Selected/Focused** state for that item.
*   **List Item (Left):** The `jpeg` item is **Selected** (highlighted blue background).
*   **Buttons:**
    *   `Buy Now`: Normal (Orange).
    *   `Filter`: Normal (Icon + Text).
    *   `Recover All ...`: Normal (Primary Blue).
    *   `Preview`: Normal/Looking like a tab header (Blue text).
*   **Search Input:** Normal, placeholder text visible.
*   **Gauge:** Static display showing "High".

**7) ICONOGRAPHY**
*   **Style:** Mostly Outline (Line) style, clean vector look.
*   **Header Icons:** Home, Back, Up Arrow, Pictures (Filled orange square with mountain), Chevron right.
*   **Toolbar Icons:** Grid view (selected/filled), Filter funnel, Search magnifying glass.
*   **Window Controls:** Minimize, Maximize/Restore, Close (X).
*   **File Type Icons:** Generic document/page icons with folded corner, specific to image types (showing landscape preview inside the icon).
*   **Status Icon:** Circular gauge with needle (filled/gradient style).

**8) STATE**
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Populated**. The scan is complete ("Scan Completed"), data is listed, and a preview is available.
*   **Selection State:** The user has selected the `jpeg` category in the left tree and the first file in the center grid (indicated by the blue border). The right pane reflects the details of this selected file.
*   **Motion Cues:** None visible (static screenshot).
